name: Watten
summary: 4-player Bavarian partnership trick-taking game with 3 permanent criticals, chosen strikers and chosen trump suit.
rules_text: Played with 32 German-suited cards, usually 4 players in two fixed pairs facing. Each gets 5 cards. Forehand chooses a rank to be Strikers (Hauptschlag is the Chief Striker of that rank plus trump suit), dealer chooses trump suit; either may ask for redeal or swap striker-choosing rights. Three Criticals (K, 7/6 Bell, 7 Spitz) are top trumps, then Chief Striker, then three Left Strikers (equal, first played wins among them), then all trumps Ace-K-O-U-10-9-8-7, then side suits. No must-follow, except when Chief Striker is led first with call "Trump or Critical!" opponents must play Critical or trump (partner trump only). Teams try to win 3 of 5 tricks. Hand normally worth 2 points, but team on lead may raise to 3,4... by asking "Gehst?" Opponents may fold (raisers get current value) or accept. First to 11 or 15 points wins; at 9/10 (or 13/14) you are gespannt and cannot raise.
rating_reason: Popular trick-taking, 2-4 players, noted fun strategic.
